$comment: Claude Desktop config. Merge the mcpServers block into your existing claude_desktop_config.json (do not overwrite other servers). Replace the API key with the crk_live_... key you minted in CoinRithm -> Settings -> API Keys. Then fully quit and reopen Claude Desktop. Needs Node.js 18+ for npx. Config file location: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json ; Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
